objective: Generate llms.txt from the complete learner-facing Canonical Shelf corpus while excluding the full BSB corpus.
acceptanceCriteria: Complete current learner-facing runtime catalog content is embedded.

Orientation, Bible-library metadata, Practice data, curated passage data, theme metadata, About disclosures, curriculum reference, Statement of Faith, theology policy, and theology sources are embedded.
Exactly 66 Bible book profiles are represented.
Curated BSB excerpts remain available where they are part of learner-facing content.
The full public/data/corpus.txt BSB corpus is linked but never embedded.
No private learner/account/feedback data or private API surface is emitted.
Generated output is deterministic and validation rejects stale output.
invariants: Statement of Faith remains the doctrinal ceiling.
Bible owns shelf/browse/reader; Topics are reference; Practice is reinforcement.

risks.mitigation: Accept size as required for completeness; exclude only the multi-megabyte full Bible corpus.

risks.risk: Structured public modules drift from llms output.
risks.mitigation: Import authoritative ESM exports during generation and validate counts/content.
Keep corpus.txt outside embedded registry and enforce an explicit validation gate.
Only read deterministic public content sources; retain API/privacy validation.

rollback: Revert the llms generator, validator, graph, plan, and regenerated public/llms.txt. No learner state or authored content migration is required.

humanReviewGates.reason: This change republishes existing approved learner-facing content without changing claims.
